# Vendored grid dependency

`fluentui-contrib-react-data-grid-react-window-1.4.2.tgz` is the existing
`@fluentui-contrib/react-data-grid-react-window` package snapshot used by the
original playground, built from the local Fluent UI Contrib checkout.

It is a dependency of the examples, not the editable prompt-component source.
The prompt component itself lives in `packages/react-prompts` and is not
vendored as an archive.
